the wave-pipelined architecture is the best suited architecture for the LDPC decoder design.

the wave pipelined ARA-LD PC encoder is the most efficient architecture for the block size of 512 bits, 1024 bits and 2048 bits.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, we have successfully designed a wave pipelined LDPC encoder architecture for ARA codes.
the wave pipelined decoder is the most efficient one and the FPGA implementation shows the performance of this design in terms of area and delay.
, the proposed architecture for ARA-LD-PC codes is efficient in both speed and area, and it is suitable for deep space communication applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the wave pipelined decoder has a better performance compared to other decoder architectures.
the wave pipelined ARA encoder is the most efficient architecture for LDPC codes and the proposed wave pipelined encoder is suitable for FPGA implementation.
the ARA-LDCPC codes are the best suited for deep space applications due to their unique features and high data transmission rate.
